scope: Additive TH18 regular Headhunter parent baseline. Hero-specific target, damage and poison data are preserved, but heroes remain outside this goal and no substitute hero mechanic is introduced.
game_version: The upstream payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. Supercell identifies Headhunter level 4 as Town Hall 18 content. The numeric level 4 and poison table is a current but unversioned secondary observation.

sources.title: The Sound of Clash Update
sources.limitations: The release note establishes Headhunter level 4 but does not publish numerical, targeting, poison, projectile or wall-crossing details.

sources.title: Headhunter
sources.limitations: The current public table supplies the L1-L4 direct values, hero multiplier, poison maximum DPS and two reduction values. It does not publish a game build, poison duration, first tick, tick interval, projectile timing, exact target ties, wall-hop geometry, or asset contract.

target_focus.note: Core preserves the hero priority as immutable targeting metadata. Since heroes are explicitly out of scope, no hero entity is materialized and the generic second-pass building fallback is the only currently executable target route.

hero_damage_multiplier.note: The source table reports fourfold direct damage against heroes. It is not applied to non-hero entities.

support.note: Core materializes the L1-L4 direct parent baseline. Hero damage, poison and wall hopping remain disabled because the required hero or timing systems are outside this goal or insufficiently documented.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only L1-L3 parent with no Core identifier, no level 4 record and no adapter route.
changed_values.replacement: L1-L4 source-backed direct parent baseline materializes through the shared Core path. The level 4 secondary observation is hash-pinned and the official release note confirms its TH18 availability.
changed_values.justification: The direct parent statistics are independently usable. Hero-only damage and poison remain preserved as sourced data without inventing an out-of-scope defender hero model.

known_uncertainties: No primary source publishes the Headhunter numeric or poison values. The imported values are secondary and have no reported client build.
Heroes, pets and hero equipment are excluded from this goal. Therefore hero priority, fourfold hero damage and poison are not exercised by a fabricated defender hero.
No consulted source publishes poison duration, application tick interval, first-tick delay, stacking, refresh, target removal, or interactions with immunity and spells.
No consulted source publishes deterministic projectile launch, travel, collision or impact timing, wall-hop geometry, target tie ordering, or source-verified sprite scaling and animation.
conclusion: Headhunter L1-L4 is executable through the shared Core, Headless CLI, Viewer and RL path as a direct non-hero parent baseline. Its hero-focused and poison-specific behaviour remains explicitly partial and is neither approximated nor presented as complete.
